author: ASHEN VOW contributors, created with Codex assistance
method: Original low-polygon hard-jointed figure; editable GDScript mesh construction and JSON poses. No external skeleton or downloaded animations.
role_variants: 18 runtime scenes. Original guard shields, archer bow/quiver, wide heavy weapons, elite/Warden headgear, and Ledger three-loop cord are authored in figure.gd and baked with the common articulated rig.
hierarchy: hips > torso > head / arm_l > elbow_l > hand_l / arm_r > elbow_r > hand_r > weapon; hips > leg_l > knee_l / leg_r > knee_r
weapon_attachment: right hand, local negative Y blade axis; grip centred at hand
animation_policy: In-place physics-driven movement. Measured horizontal displacement drives a stance/return cycle with analytic two-link hard-jointed legs. Authored anticipation/active/recovery weights share the combat clock; hit/death/attack owns its pose. Exponential blending handles other states. Terrain-aware planted-foot IK is not implemented.
limitations: Hard joints, no skin deformation, finger motion, facial animation, IK or exact planted-foot solver. These are original stylized fallback assets, not motion capture or production-polished animation.
